summary: Retest of BarcodeScanner.tsx re-arm/debounce fix + regression suite (tag design, print-tags, admin audit CSV). All 9 checks passed (2 new browser checks + 1 new backend test file + 2 new backend tests for audit.csv, 6 re-run existing artifacts). Backend suite has 1 pre-existing data-state failure (shops_seeded needs_zone_review) unrelated to this iteration's change.

checks.criterion: Scanner re-arms after a non-matching camera decode so the next barcode still fires onDetected
checks.name: scanner-rearms-after-nonmatch-decode
checks.evidence: Stubbed getUserMedia + patched BrowserMultiFormatReader.prototype.decodeFromCanvas (first call -> bogus text, subsequent calls -> seeded SKU). Toast 'No item matches that barcode' shown, scanner-dialog stayed open; within ~1.7s the next decode fired onDetected again, closed the dialog and navigated to /tag/{seeded_item_id}, tag-title matched. Only console error was the expected 404 from the bogus-SKU lookup.

checks.criterion: Repeated decode of the SAME barcode within the cooldown window fires onDetected exactly once (debounce)
checks.name: scanner-debounces-duplicate-decode
checks.evidence: decodeFromCanvas patched to always return the seeded SKU; counted /api/inventory/lookup requests for that SKU via page.on('request') — exactly 1 call, single navigation to /tag/{id}, scanner-dialog closed once, no re-fire.

checks.criterion: Previous suite still passes: tag design (no QR, sticker outline, charity line, CONDITION above price, RRP under price, condition wraps not overlaps)
checks.name: tag-page-new-design-no-qr
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check: no QR code rendered on /tag/{id}, sticker outline + charity copy present.

checks.criterion: Previous suite still passes: price block layout (CONDITION above price, RRP under price)

checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check: layout order confirmed for both RRP-present and RRP-absent cases.

checks.name: print-tags-a6-new-design-pdf-and-dom
checks.evidence: PDF text extracted: 'CONDITION: Good PRICE £15.00 RRP £80.00 All proceeds go to charity' — matches expected copy, no QR.

checks.evidence: PDF text extracted with CONDITION:/PRICE/RRP/charity line present for A7 sheet.

action_items: Pre-existing, out-of-scope: backend test_tscheck_shops_seeded_data.py::test_shops_seeded_with_14_known_branches fails (Chiswick High Road needs_zone_review expected True, got False) — a seeded-data mismatch unrelated to the BarcodeScanner.tsx change under test; not newly introduced by this iteration. test_tscheck_ai_quota_indexes.py and two appraise/ai-quota tests failed once on the full run due to 'Event loop is closed' (xdist worker teardown) and a real-model appraise call, and passed individually on rerun — classified flaky/environment, not a regression from this change.
